notes: Upstream animates a line through three tribble points (2020-01-01,2),(2020-02-01,4),(2020-03-01,3) via R gganimate transition_reveal, rendered to a GIF. The R payload cannot run on Jenner (SAS engine). This bundle reproduces the same three-point series as a native SAS dataset, maps the dates to a numeric axis the way the R code does with as.numeric(ymd(time)) (INPUT + yymmdd10.), and computes the drawn line's per-segment slopes plus a MEANS summary. Data and variables derive from the repo's actual tribble content.
